plotSections.title: Reach travel and exhaustion plan
bullets: Walker finalizes a 49-day itinerary in The Reach, spending five dragon energy per day for a total of 245 energy points.
He accepts one level of exhaustion per day for the full stay, giving him disadvantage on ability checks throughout the trip.
The DM confirms this plan can still be changed if Walker wants to adjust mid-journey.

plotSections.title: Exhaustion lore and remedies
bullets: Dragon riders have no reliable cure for travel exhaustion except labor-intensive potion-making.
Cleric or paladin magic can reduce exhaustion, but Dana and Ord are not with Walker’s group.
Walker asks whether Elrus can cure exhaustion daily; the answer is no.
Nicotine is described as short-term effective for pushing through exhaustion, but withdrawal without a steady supply is harsh; Walker makes a mental note to acquire nicotine after giving up alcohol.

plotSections.title: Detour to Sunder
bullets: Walker plans to fly with Elrus and Plymouth toward the training grounds, routing over Sunder.
He offers a detour stop in Sunder to shop for supplies, especially an exhaustion potion.
The DM agrees Sunder may carry exhaustion potions and other hard-to-get supplies.
Elrus declines supplies and says he does not like frequenting Sunder often; Walker offers jerky and salt leaf anyway.
The group will meet in the mountains after the Sunder stop.

plotSections.title: Communication while separated
bullets: Walker tells Ciri that mind-link communication is open if she needs anything, since she uses it better than he does.
The DM notes mind chat has limited range and would likely require a spell at this distance.
Fire signals have not been taught to Walker; the DM also raises flag signaling as an alternative.
